description: This file contains shell script code that defines test cases for pull signature verification in a Git project. It sets up repositories with various signed and unsigned commits, then runs tests to verify the behavior of 'git pull' with signature verification options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test scenario with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, and verifies failure.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a file output.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test.
